description: This Java class defines the 'Project' entity for a JPA/Hibernate ORM mapping within a larger enterprise application. It models project-related data, including identifiers, title, start/end dates, and associations to clients and employee projects.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Entity class representing a Project with fields for ID, title, start/end dates, associated client, and related employee-project mapping.

methods.name: getProjectTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the project.

methods.name: getDateStarted
methods.description: Returns the date when the project was started.

methods.name: setDateStarted
methods.description: Sets the start date of the project.

methods.name: getDateEnded
methods.description: Returns the date when the project ended.

methods.name: setDateEnded
methods.description: Sets the end date for the project.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves the client associated with the project.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Associates a client with the project.

methods.name: getEmployeeProjects
methods.description: Retrieves the set of EmployeeProject associations for the project.

methods.name: setEmployeeProjects
methods.description: Sets the collection of EmployeeProject associations for the project.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides the default method to compare projects based on field values.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on project fields for use in hashed collections.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the project entity for debugging.
